name: SCP: Rezonans
source:
The game takes place today, in the multifaceted universe of SCP.

The main character is Galen, a simple scientist in Site 13. Recently, Galen graduated from the Faculty of Psychology and was recruited to work with SCP objects. You will be given the story of Galen, who is just starting her career at the SCP Foundation. But is everything so simple here? You have to plunge into the otmasshere of the fund, choose from several options for the development of events and build your own destiny. There is danger at every step. Be on the alert, even friends may turn out to be enemies. This is a visual novel that requires the player to make rational decisions and informed choices. Choose from several options and try to survive.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1151720/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
游戏发生在今天，在SCP的多层面宇宙中。

主角是盖伦，13号站点的一位简单科学家。最近，盖伦从心理学系毕业，并被招募从事SCP项目的工作。你将了解盖伦的故事，她刚刚在SCP基金会开始她的职业生涯。但这里的一切就这么简单吗？你必须投入到基金的大世界中，从事件发展的多种选项中进行选择，并建立自己的命运。每一步都有危险。保持警惕，即使是朋友也可能变成敌人。这是一部需要玩家做出理性决定和明智选择的视觉小说。从多个选项中进行选择并尝试生存。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1151720/]Steam[/url]]
